# 1 Enoch Chapter 46 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Parables (Similitudes)

---

**1** There I saw someone with a Head of Days — his hair white as wool — and with him was another figure who looked like a human being. His face radiated grace, like one of the holy angels.

**2** I asked the angel guiding me through these hidden things, 'Who is this Son of Man? Where does he come from? Why is he with the Head of Days?'

**3** The angel answered: 'This is the Son of Man — the one who embodies righteousness, the one in whom righteousness lives. He reveals every hidden treasure, because the Lord of Spirits chose him. His standing before the Lord of Spirits surpasses everything — forever, in perfect integrity.

**4** This Son of Man you have seen will topple kings and strip the powerful from their thrones. He will shatter the grip of the mighty and smash the teeth of sinners.

**5** He will dethrone kings and dismantle kingdoms — because they refused to honor and praise God, because they never acknowledged where their power came from.

**6** He will humiliate the powerful until shame fills their faces. Darkness will be their home and worms their bed. They will never rise from that place — because they refused to honor the name of the Lord of Spirits.

**7** These are the ones who presume to judge the stars of heaven, who raise their fists against the Most High, who stomp across the earth as if they own it. Everything they do reeks of injustice. Their power comes from their wealth, and they put their trust in gods their own hands made. They reject the name of the Lord of Spirits.

**8** They will be thrown out of God's assembly and out of the community of the faithful — those who hold to the name of the Lord of Spirits.


---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering aimed at modern English readability. Ge'ez idioms are rendered by their functional English equivalents. Theological terms are translated for impact rather than etymological precision.*
